prompt:
Create a NEW finished educational illustration in Traditional Chinese. Reference image is ONLY for white background, metal material, thin pale blue rounded borders, concrete visual evidence and navy headline. NEVER copy reference labels or numbers. Exactly 3 major visual nodes, strong blue arrows for real causal flow only. Images dominate, few short large labels. No page or stage number badges, no logo. Title exactly supplied. ONE bottom #FFF4CC pale yellow lightbulb takeaway, exact supplied sentence, all fully visible. Small『教學示意』. Source/evidence notes are context not to print as paragraphs. No fake metrics. INDEPENDENT MOBILE PORTRAIT about 768x2048. Three large stages TOP TO BOTTOM, arrows down. Reflow within each stage, no shrunk desktop columns. Large short labels readable at328px width, title/footnote wraps, never clip footer. Title: 背景相減：先記住背景，再找出新來的工件
Story: 主體固定俯視灰色輸送帶，有固定兩條側軌，银色方形工件向右經過。第一大區「先學背景」：多張不同時間的空帶與工件曾經過的影片縮圖，向下箭頭到同座標乾淨空帶背景，旁邊三個像素位置的灰階小分布表示常見外觀，標「累積常見外觀」，不是唯一一張照片。第二大區「對照現在」：上方同空帶背景，下方目前一片銀色方塊位於中央，短比較括號，不把背景變成工件；標「新工件不同於背景」。第三大區「前景候選」：同座標黑底遮罩中央一個白方形，旁邊小型原影片回看標「檢查進入區域」；底下橘色短註「陰影需另處理」。本圖是二值前景示意、背景相減不是物件分類。
Exact takeaway: 背景模型記住常態，前景只是需要查看的候選。
